svg.title: Serving size as maximum recommended amount per eating occasion

svg.text: Serving size is the maximum per eating occasion
Suggested use on label: "Take 1–3 tablets with breakfast"
Serving Size must be: 3 tablets (maximum per eating occasion)

All amounts below the bar are per that serving — not per bottle
